answerCheck.reason: The promise says all answers correct implies an A. Its contrapositive says no A implies not all answers correct, which means at least one multiple-choice answer is wrong. It does not imply that all answers are wrong.

For P meaning every multiple-choice answer right and Q meaning an A, P implies Q entails not-Q implies not-P. Negating every answer being right gives at least one wrong answer, B. The other choices do not follow: an A need not require any correct multiple-choice answers, and a non-A student need not have every answer wrong.
